verdict.rationale: There is no first-party evidence of a native way to launch or orchestrate fleets of parallel agents. The only building blocks are headless non-interactive runs for scripting (gh-6, gh-17, gh-18), session checkpointing to save and resume (gh-8), and GitHub-based task delegation via @gemini-cli mentions (gh-12). Running agents in parallel for long periods would need external orchestration built by the user, and hands-on reports of agent-mode loops and failures on agentic tasks (comm-10, comm-11) cast doubt on multi-hour autonomy. Missing for 10: native multi-agent/fleet orchestration, documented parallel task execution, evidence of reliable hours-to-days autonomous runs, independent corroboration.
